dedupe_keys.name: data driven models for levee breach flows

description: Data-Driven Models For Levee Breach Flows is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by BALACHANDRAN, SHIVAKUMAR (deposited on HydroShare). This study deals with data-driven models that can estimate the breach discharge and approach depth for levee breach flows. The ML models are trained from the data sourced from the validated 2D numerical models. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2025-07-09 and last updated 2026-09-29; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the resource metadata. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
